Gold Std Ventures (GSV) Position Has Upped by Cibc Asset Management Inc; Berkshire Money Management Increases Stake in Apple (AAPL)
June 17, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Cibc Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Gold Std Ventures Corp (GSV) by 1335.33% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cibc Asset Management Inc bought 742,978 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.42% with the market. The institutional investor held 798,618 shares of the mining & quarrying of nonmetallic minerals (no fuels) company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.31 million, up from 55,640 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cibc Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Gold Std Ventures Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $310.77M market cap company. The stock increased 0.83% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $1.22. About 3.06 million shares traded or 690.95% up from the average. Gold Standard Ventures Corp (NYSEMKT:GSV) has declined 2.48% since June 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.05% the S&P500. Some Historical GSV News: 10/05/2018 JP Morgan Chase Buys New 1% Position in Gold Standard Ventures
Berkshire Money Management Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 141.41% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Berkshire Money Management Inc bought 2,100 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3,585 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $601,000, up from 1,485 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Berkshire Money Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $928.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.03% or $1.96 during the last trading session, reaching $188.84. About 33.10M shares traded or 10.09% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. It also reduced its holding in United Technologies Corp (NYSE:UTX) by 3,521 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 71,558 shares, and cut its stake in United Parcel Service Inc (NYSE:UPS).
